purpose: Historical local-file ingestion profile. It is lineage only; context/profile.json is the MotherDuck runtime source-of-truth profile.

checks: Strict CSV parsing with header and all_varchar; all source headers recorded in schema.yaml
Exact row counts, distinct source IDs and null source IDs for all CSVs
Full transaction timestamp and DECIMAL(18,2) amount parsing
Every exposed schema projection evaluated across its entire source, with canonical null counts
Full source-key joins and transaction/card owner consistency
Full categorical frequencies for card attributes, gender, transaction methods and error strings
not_validated: Meaning of positive/negative amounts, settlement status or fraud outcomes
Dataset publisher, license, synthetic provenance, time zone or ISO currency
Customer/card snapshot effective dates or historical accuracy
Value-level correctness and formatting of excluded personal/payment fields
External merchant identities or MCC standards beyond the supplied lookup

reported_card_count_comparison.interpretation: The named num_credit_cards field equals all inventory card rows for every user in this snapshot. Do not interpret its name as Credit-type-only without this caveat.

reproduction_queries_after_canonical_pre: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id), MIN(transaction_at), MAX(transaction_at), MIN(amount), MAX(amount), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount < 0), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount = 0), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount > 0), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE errors IS NOT NULL) FROM transactions

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.client_id IS NULL), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.card_id IS NULL), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.card_id IS NOT NULL AND t.client_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.client_id), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.mcc IS NULL) FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN users u ON t.client_id=u.client_id LEFT JOIN cards c ON t.card_id=c.card_id LEFT JOIN mcc_codes m ON t.mcc=m.mcc
SELECT transaction_method, COUNT(*) FROM transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT errors, COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE errors IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT card_brand, card_type, COUNT(*) FROM cards GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT gender, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
refresh_policy: Invalidate this profile if any source SHA-256 changes. Re-run the declared projections, full counts, null checks, key/relationship checks and distributions before refreshing observations. Fixture tests alone do not refresh this profile.
